verification_recipe.execution_gate: First require G admission of the exact request/profile bridge and accepted Catalog/Legal source pins, plus the L01 local metadata packet. Then run only the exact same-profile HTTP consumer against a read-only selected production generation with a fresh reader. Keep all production payload local.
verification_recipe.positive: Use the admitted Catalog profile and its actual resolved encoder against the selected complete Legal generation; an independently chosen known target must be returned through the ordinary HTTP route while the matched decoy is not. Verify the response identifies success distinctly from a profile refusal or zero matches.
fake_or_foreign: Same label and dimension, changed actual weights/tokenizer: profile gate refuses before native knn_query; do not accept name/dimension as identity.
A profile/source/generation bound to a different Legal source or encoder is refused before HNSW.
Missing, unknown, disabled, stale, unsupported-rule, or unpaired profile/generation fails with a typed refusal; it must not collapse into an empty-success response.
LA-028 selection controls: omitted/None is distinct from explicit empty; disabled or missing mandatory seeds and cycles refuse with their typed reason.
verification_recipe.removal: On a matched target/decoy fixture or approved local discriminating case, remove only the encoder-identity/profile gate while preserving the selected generation and real HNSW consumer. The same-dimensional wrong vector should select the decoy; restoring the gate must refuse that query and preserve the positive target result. Existing c60 fixture test test_raw_vector_cannot_bypass_query_profile_gate_and_control_is_discriminating demonstrates this structural removal, not production authenticity.
freshness_and_pairing: Replace the selector during a blocked encode: one request remains on one immutable generation; a subsequent request with the previous encoder refuses.

Changed projected text at same ID, withdrawal/current-membership change, changed same-dimension encoder/tokenizer, projection-rule change, missing/corrupt selector, or NPZ/HNSW mismatch cannot reuse the old Legal generation.

P38_property_vs_proxy.property: Ordinary HTTP request resolves an admitted Catalog profile to the live Legal encoder bound to the selected generation, then returns the actual fresh Legal reader result or a distinguishable typed refusal.
P38_property_vs_proxy.what_G_actually_exercises: The HTTP DTO contains query/top_k/output_dir and the handler calls text_search; it does not exercise profile resolution or vector query encoding.
P38_property_vs_proxy.what_candidate_tests_actually_exercise: Direct LegalKnowledgeGraph/LegalKnowledgeStore construction with an injected deterministic encoder and tiny fixture database/native HNSW.
P38_property_vs_proxy.divergent_case: The direct fixture can return its target while the real G POST never calls that encoder and returns lexical results; conversely, handler exceptions can look like no matches. A passing constructor fixture therefore does not prove the HTTP property.
P38_property_vs_proxy.distinguishing_probe: Keep fixture and marker tests unchanged while withholding/removing the HTTP profile-to-encoder bridge. If a proposed I4 gate remains green although POST still reaches text_search only, it is a proxy gate.
